action.value: Cijena na cjeniku za unesenu robu nije definirana - želite li dohvatiti cijenu s master cjenika?

data.command: select cast(@Kolicina * (coalesce(@NaknadaNZ, 0) + coalesce(@NaknadaPO, 0) + coalesce(@NaknadaTR, 0)) as decimal(18,2)) as Naknade
data.name: dtNaknadeKalk

data.command: select IsNull(NetoCijenaKn, 0) as RobaCijena from Cjenik where RobaId = @RobaId and VrCjenikId = (select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'MasterCjenikId')
data.name: dtRobaMasterCjenik
